description: Queensland mining and exploration tenure series is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. The datasets in this series are a digital representation of the extent of current mining and exploration tenures in Queensland. Refer to individual datasets for further details. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. It offers 42 resource(s) in gdb, rest, shp, shp, tab, fgdb, kmz, gpkg, wms. The portal shows 2025-09-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
